newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 30 massacred in Colombian village.
newsitem.headline: At least 30 massacred in Colombian village.

text.p: A suspected right-wing death squad has massacred more than 30 people in a remote village in eastern Colombia, a regional Red Cross chief said on Monday.
The attack took place in Mapiripan in Meta province over the weekend but the exact death toll was not immediately known, Teddy Torbeaum, head of the Red Cross in Meta, told Reuters.

"I met the mayor of Mapiripan this morning and he told me that at least 30 people had been massacred. But we will not know exactly how many dead there are until we can recover the corpses," Torbeaum said in a telephone interview.
"The mayor said a paramilitary group carried out the attack but I cannot confirm that personally," he added.
Torbeaum said at least 200 people who feared fresh attacks had been flown from the village of about 1,000 people in military aircraft.

Local media reported some victims had been decapitated and tortured. The motive for the killings was not immediately clear, although right-wing death squads frequently target those they suspect of collaborating with leftist rebels.
